sections.Overview of Care Supreme: Care Supreme is Care Health Insurance’s all-around health plan for buyers who want flexible family cover, no room-rent cap, and strong restoration. At Ditto, we shortlist it for its comprehensive yet affordable coverage because it is rated 4.41/5 under Ditto’s comprehensive policy rating framework , offers a sum insured of ₹5 lakh to ₹1 crore, and includes unlimited restoration. We rate health plans on benefits, exclusions, waiting periods, room rent, restoration, price, network strength, complaints, and claims metrics. This plan is especially relevant for families, seniors, and individuals seeking chronic-condition add-ons. It features zero co-payment, 60-day pre- and 180-day post-hospitalization coverage, a network of over 11,400 hospitals, and an optional Instant Cover rider that reduces select pre-existing disease (PED) waiting periods to just 30 days.

sections.Pros: Offers a wide range of features. Great pick if you're looking for something affordable. Insurer has a solid track record with great claim and service metrics. You can pick any room you like, a highly valued feature. Unlimited Restoration Benefit, which adds significant value to the policy.
sections.Cons: Your insurer doesn't provide free health check-ups, which is a notable gap. Maternity benefits not offered, which could be a drawback for some. Doctor consultations are not covered, which is a key feature. Need to opt add-on for doctor consultations.
sections.Founded: 2012 Care was established 14 years ago and has built strong credibility over time, backed by its long-standing presence in the market.
sections.Claims Experience: 95% CSR, calculated as a 3-year average Care settles 95% of all claims it receives demonstrating strong credibility.
sections.Network Hospitals: 11,400+ Care has a strong network with over 11,400 hospitals, ensuring wide accessibility and convenience for policyholders.
sections.Complaints: 43 complaints per 10,000 claims registered Care has a relatively high volume of complaints, which may point to ongoing issues in customer service or claim handling.
sections.Add-ons of Care Supreme: Reduction in PED Recommended For any illness: Pre existing disease waiting period is modified/reduced from 3 years to 1 and 2 years. Instant Cover Recommended For Hypertension, Diabetes, Cholesterol and Asthma: Pre existing disease waiting period is reduced from 3 years to 30 days. Cumulative Bonus Super Recommended Additional bonus of 100% up to a maximum of 500%, irrespective of any claim in the previous year. Care OPD Recommended Total 8 doctor consultations with 4 from General Physicians capped at ₹500 and 4 from Specified Specialists capped at ₹500. Claim Shield Recommended Covers list of 68 non-medical items as per list I BeFit Recommended Get unlimited visit access to empaneled Fitness centres/Gyms. Instant Cover Plus Recommended For Hypertension, Diabetes, Cholesterol, Asthma, Obesity, Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), Obesity or Coronary Artery Disease (PTCA done prior to 1 yr): Pre existing disease waiting period is reduced from 3 years to 30 days. Cumulative Bonus Booster Recommended Additional bonus of 100% up to infinity, irrespective of any claim in the previous year. Wellness Benefits Recommended Up to a 30% discount on renewal premiums for maintaining a healthy lifestyle Annual Health Checkup Annual health check-up for specified tests, with a maximum limit up to the sum insured on a cashless or reimbursement basis. Claim Shield Plus Covers non-medical items as per list I, II, III & IV Air Ambulance You can avail an air ambulance in the event of an emergency up to Rs. 5 Lakhs per policy year. Unlimited Care Unlimited coverage (without any upper cap) for one claim during the Policy lifetime.

sections.Frequently Asked Questions: Does Care Supreme have waiting periods? Yes. Care Supreme imposes 3 kinds of waiting periods - 30-Day Waiting Period: Hospitalizations won’t be covered for the first 30 days of the policy unless it’s an accident. Specific Illness Waiting Period: There’s a 2-year waiting period for a list of diseases which is a mandate before you can start claiming. Pre-Existing Disease Waiting Period: There's a 3-year waiting period for any pre-existing disease you may have while buying the policy. Does Care Supreme have room rent restrictions? No. Care Supreme lets you stay in any room available in the hospital - Single Private Room, Share Room, Deluxe Room, etc. Does Care Supreme offer a restoration benefit? Yes, Care Supreme does offer a restoration benefit. Your sum insured gets reinstated back to 100% any number of times you make a claim, in a policy year. Does Care Supreme cover AYUSH treatments? Yes. Care Supreme does cover AYUSH Treatments. Does Care Supreme offer a bonus? Yes. Care Supreme offers a bonus. Every year on renewal, your sum insured grows by 50% up to a maximum of 100% of the sum insured. Does Care Supreme offer maternity benefits? No. Care Supreme does not offer maternity benefits. Does Care Supreme offer international coverage? No. Care Supreme does not offer international coverage. Does Care Supreme offer dental protection? Yes. Care Supreme does offer dental treatments in case of injury or accidents. Does Care Supreme offer coverage for outpatient consultations? Yes. Care Supreme does offer Outpatient Consultations - packaged as an optional cover/add-on. How are the premiums calculated for Care Supreme? The premiums are calculated after taking into account your age, your location (zonal), your medical condition, (any pre-existing diseases), and lifestyle habits (smoking, drinking, etc.) Can I avail myself of a discount on Care Supreme? Yes. Care Supreme does provide a discount. The insurer offers a discount of 7.5% on the premium amount in the 2nd year if you pay for 2 year policy term in advance and an additional 10% off on the third year  premium if you pay for 3 year policy term in advance. Does Care Supreme have entry and exit restrictions? Yes. This policy has an entry age of 18 years with no exit age. However, it provides coverage for dependent children from the age of 3 months to 24 years. View all
